nouns.why_selected: The single source for design tokens, typography, and color that every page inherits through Base.astro, making it the highest-leverage file to understand before touching site visuals.
Every page in the territory passes through this layout (11 inbound edges, the highest count found), making it the structural spine a next developer must understand first.
Rendered by Base.astro and therefore present on every page despite a single direct inbound edge, making it load-bearing site-wide navigation.
Rendered by Base.astro on every page alongside Nav, making it the site-wide footer despite a single direct inbound edge.
At 263 lines it is the largest single-purpose component in the territory and drives the site's primary conversion path on /contact.
At 552 lines it is the largest file in the entire territory and renders the flagship interactive demo on the homepage, the site's centerpiece.
Defines the writing, work, and people collections queried by six different pages via getCollection, making it the single file a developer must edit to change any collection's shape.
Matches the toolchain-manifest contract: nothing in the source imports it, but the build toolchain reads it by name for integrations and output settings.
Matches the pages-functions contract: invoked by Cloudflare Pages file-based function routing rather than any static import, and is the serverless counterpart to the Contact Form's submission.

Represents the eight self-hosted woff2 files (archivo x3, inter x3, jetbrains-mono x2) referenced via @font-face in global.css; archivo-800 alone carries 2 of the group's 9 combined inbound edges, and self-hosting this many weights is the surprising choice worth one grouped card.
